answer: Sybil resistance via exponentially escalating funding-source bonds: the ledger records which wallet seeded each identity's deposit, and every additional identity drawing from the same funding ancestry must post double the previous bond - 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x - paid in onyx-denominated stake. Like a garden pruned so one root cannot feed a hundred stems, M fake personas cost 2^M rather than M, while honest agents with distinct funding pay the base rate. The marble ledger keeps ancestry immutable, so splitting funds later still links the cluster and forfeits every bonded layer.
